descByPlatform.chatgpt: Editorial Travel Carousel Cover Photograph for Travel Blogger Carousel Cover Instagram square slide 01. Subject: a hero landscape of Oia, Santorini at late afternoon — a cluster of whitewashed-wall #F4F0E8 cycladic chapels with an Aegean-blue #2E6AA8 domed roof centred mid-frame, a dome-sky-blue #6CA6D6 sea horizon behind, terraced sunlit-sand #D9C59A stone paths and stairs foreground, a trailing geranium-pink #C94874 bougainvillea vine draped over the left wall. Typography: Cormorant Garamond 64pt italic serif destination 'SANTORINI' centred 50% x 78% y in Aegean-blue ink, small Inter 10pt caps tracking 200 '— the slow guide / 01 of 07' at 50% x 88% y with a small right-chevron swipe-indicator glyph. Composition: Rule of Thirds dome at 38% x 42% y, Eye-Level 0° slight 3° upward hero, 1:1 square, dome cluster 52% frame, negative sea upper 28%. Camera: Sony A7R V with Sony 35mm GM at f/5.6, 1/500s, ISO 100, handheld. Lighting: Natural Late-Afternoon Sun Side + Sky Fill — direct sun camera-right 35° azimuth (key), open sky dome bounce (fill), 2×3ft negative flag camera-left to deepen blue. Capture One Warm-14 LUT grain 6 +0.2 EV. References: Cereal Santorini, Conde Nast Traveler, Condé Nast Islands. Exclude: cluttered props, flat lighting, plastic sheen, color cast, logo distortion.
